title: Ring push guide: latency budget breakdown
description: Section analyzing the 2-second budget. Server processing (VTCCall create, VTCParticipant creates, push construction): target <100ms. Push delivery (APNs/FCM/Web Push transit): typically 200-800ms. Client wake and UI render: 200-500ms for native, 500-1500ms for web. Where time is lost (cold start, certificate validation, push batching). Monitoring recommendations (instrument each segment).
